critique_summary: The fleet is suffering from extreme cross-bot correlation in the Kraken segment, specifically on RENDER and ATOM shorts which have a 0% and 40% win rate respectively. Navigator is severely overexposed to JPY shorts during a news blackout, resulting in a -3.08% drawdown. Oracle is correctly positioned in SGOV, but the trade history shows critical data leakage between Kraken and Alpaca logging systems.
critique_flags: Data leakage in Oracle trade history logs
